description.narrative: The Program will provide project financing for the rehabilitation of the track and structure of the Sumgayit-Yalama rail line--a key link in the North-South Railway Corridor within the Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation network. It will improve rail network serviceability (the project loan); and support the railway sector development reforms in management autonomy and governance, financial restructuring, reporting and control, operational efficiency, and corporate restructuring (the policy-based loan).

Output: Financial restructuring of ADY's debt liabilities effectively conducted. Indicator: Debt-Service-Coverage Ratio reached 1.1 by 2024 (2016 baseline: negative). Achievement: 1.02 Progress/Status: Debt-service-coverage ratio as of end 2020 is 0.3; target was not achieved due to the negative effects of pandemic on ADY operations (e.g., significant reduction in freight and passenger operations). On 13 April 2023, ADB approved the deferment of financial covenant compliance related to DSCR. ADY expects to achieve the target in 2024 to be reported in AEFS FY2024 (due for submission in 2025). Data Source: ADY's annual financial statements

Output: Financial and management control, efficiency and reporting at ADY enhanced. Indicator: Unqualified ADY's Annual Audited Financial Statements achieved by 2024 (2016 baseline: not undertaken). Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Unqualified APFS from FY2018 to 2023, except for FY2021. Qualified AEFS from FY2018 to FY2023 due to non-compliance to loan covenant referring to (i) achieving DSCR target and (ii) regular adjustment and application of freight/passenger tariff. On 13 April 2023, ADB approved the deferment of financial covenant compliance related to DSCR that is expected to result to unqualified APFS thereafter. The target timeline to achieve the financial covenant was revised from 2020 to 2024. APFS FY2024 and AEFS FY2024 are not yet due but expected to be unqualified. Data Source: ADY Annual Report Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2024 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Financial restructuring of ADY's debt liabilities effectively conducted. Indicator: Credit Rating from an international rating agency procured by 2019 (2016 baseline: no credit rating). Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved. ADY submitted all required information to the rating agency, Moody's, in October 2018 and obtained the credit rating on 11 March 2019. This was a crucial milestone to enable ADY's return to accessing credit markets and rate its financial transparency and governance, and sets a key benchmark for management performance assessment. The rating agency has made recommendations to improve the rating over a period of 3-5 years, including solutions like those included in the scope of the program, e.g., contractual subsidy arrangements with the government to cover losses in mandated passenger services (PSO) and infrastructure maintenance (SPA), and partially converting state debt into equity. ADY is already implementing all the recommendations. Data Source: Contract with a credit rating agency Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2019 Target value: Y Actual value: Y
